title: slime life
description: a medium mod searching to make playing hardcore easier. The mod pack is made around to principe: it needs to feel alive and dangerous
body:
this modpack as been made to change the way we see minecraft world. 

it is made to be played in hardcore with a group of friend. A lot of creatures and new boss are making it fun to explore without to much difficulties.

Bosses'Rise: is one of the main mod adding boss
farmer delight: is adding new food
create: more way to farm diferent loot
thirst was taken:adds a turst mechanic

those are the 5 mod that change and rule this modpack. A lot of other mod adds new loot and new mob
